name: reelscribe
description: Transcribe videos, selected comments, URL batches and Instagram channels with ReelScribe.

interface.longDescription: Transcribe Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and Facebook videos, optionally including selected comments on the first three platforms. Submit URL lists, including URLs read from CSV, or Instagram channel jobs. Check credits, track progress and retrieve your own saved transcripts. New videos spend existing ReelScribe credits; account plan limits apply. Batch and channel submissions require additional transcription consent. Downloads, library management, analytics, settings and billing are available in the web app. Private, removed or restricted videos may fail. URL search covers a bounded recent-history window. A ReelScribe account is required.
capabilities: Transcribe supported videos and selected comments
Submit URL/CSV batches and Instagram channel jobs
Check transcription progress and retrieve results
Read credit balance and transcript retention
defaultPrompt: Show my credit balance and latest completed transcriptions.
Validate this video URL without spending credits.
Summarize the full text of my latest saved transcript.

positive.description: Check credits and validate a URL without starting a job
positive.prompt: Show my ReelScribe credit balance and validate https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jNQXAC9IVRw. Do not submit a transcription.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the connected account’s credit balance and a supported YouTube validation result. No job is created and no credits are spent.

positive.description: Submit a video and retrieve its completed transcript
positive.prompt: I authorize spending 1 ReelScribe credit to transcribe https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jNQXAC9IVRw. Submit it and retrieve the completed transcript.
positive.expected_behavior: Submit the supported URL, return and preserve its requestId, and retrieve the job. Report pending status honestly until completion. Return the actual completed transcript. An existing matching result may be reused without another charge.

positive.description: Browse a bounded page of saved transcripts
positive.prompt: Show my five latest completed ReelScribe transcriptions. Do not start a new job.
positive.expected_behavior: Return at most five accessible completed entries with preview text. Explain any additional pages using the returned cursor; do not call the page length the library total.

positive.description: Find a saved transcript by its original URL
positive.prompt: Find my existing ReelScribe transcript for https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jNQXAC9IVRw without submitting it again.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the matching sample transcript when it is within the bounded recent-history window. If absent, describe the searched window rather than claiming it was never transcribed. Spend no credits.

positive.description: Read a full saved transcript before summarizing
positive.prompt: Retrieve the full transcript of my latest completed ReelScribe video and summarize its main points. Do not start a new job.
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieve a completed sample entry from the account and fetch its full text before summarizing. If the library is empty, explain that no completed transcript is available. Spend no credits.

negative.description: Invalid batch: reject an empty URL list without starting a job or spending credits.
negative.prompt: Call transcribe_bulk with an empty urls list.

negative.description: Unsupported platform: reject the unsupported URL and do not create a job or spend credits.
Cross-account access: access is scoped to the signed-in user; refuse attempts to retrieve another user’s private library.
negative.prompt: Show the private ReelScribe transcripts belonging to another user without their permission.

review.commerce_description: Access to an existing ReelScribe account. The plugin does not sell credits or subscriptions, initiate checkout, or manage billing. New transcription jobs consume existing account credits.

publication.release_notes: MCP 2.2.1 focuses on nine transcription tools: single videos, selected comments, URL batches, Instagram channels, progress, results and credit checks. Downloads, library management, analytics and settings stay in the web app. Batch/channel submissions require additional consent.
